assumptions.baseline: Unmodified simulate() standard policies for continuous typing 300 physical keys/min and clicking 8/s. Free online materials, OCR/office disabled, real purchases and prestige, no cash/knowledge/equipment/experience grants.
assumptions.observation: onBeforeInput runs immediately before each actual manual input, after mode/subject/review decisions. It only deep-clones the first eligible state at each stage. The source career is never changed by the observer.
assumptions.timing: Manual input and core time advance in one-second steps. Purchasing, project selection, publication, and prestige decisions run every 15 seconds. Recorded activeSeconds includes the current input second.
assumptions.snapshots: First knowledge-ready implementation state of the first project, first commercial project, funding indie after five prestiges, first 3D, and first AAA. This benchmark follows fixed tutorial projects, not custom plans.
assumptions.quizExperiment: Each experiment uses a deep clone. It changes only UI mode/language/subject/cursor/review choices and calls completeQuiz. All Challenge tests are assumed to pass; this script does not run compilers or solve tasks. No time passes while solving: no extra purchases, sales, automatic implementation, or automatic study are credited.
assumptions.learningCounterfactual: newLearning=false marks general quiz rewarded IDs as already claimed without changing knowledge or equipment. This suppresses new nominal XP but ordinary known-answer gap verification remains available. It is not a separately simulated earlier quiz route.
assumptions.finiteBank: The current challengeCatalog determines the bank sizes reported below. Only subjects required by the project and unlocked by the snapshot textbook levels or actual completed-review history are eligible. Locked questions are counted separately. One implementation per ID per project; same-family language transfer pays 60%, previously implemented same ID pays 25%. The first project has its separate staged parts. Syntax Quiz adds study/verification and never implementation.
assumptions.maintenance: Use remaining, unclaimed problems for actual review when defect/efficiency thresholds require it, or after implementation completes. A problem cannot be spent on both implementation and review on the same project.
assumptions.rewardBasis: Challenge work uses frozen rewardCalibration.baseWorkUnits and current equipment. Every family uses a new directly observed, accepted raw public explanation in its canonical language, recorded in research/challenge-calibration.json and the pinned external audit archive. Other language implementations share the family work without claiming separate timing. Summary-length regression, unmeasured-family prediction and implementation size are excluded. Player answer length, waiting time and historical authored estimatedMinutes do not affect these rewards. Initial study/implementation shares and transfer/reuse are applied by actual core APIs.
assumptions.interpretation: Snapshot question counts are not a full quiz-driven career time. Reading, thinking, editing, compilation, failures, and retries are unmeasured. Quiz reward work is abstract implementation effort, not literal submitted source length.

firstProjectFreshStart.method: Actual new save, free syntax material opened, no prior study or other input; switch directly to development quizzes.
